audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gave Xerath level 1 and 'Skill' for every other row; the content layer and packet levelChart both give Orianna level 1 and Xerath rows 1-6. Every row disagreed across the two layers.
audit.why: Before Arcanopulse is levelled Orianna's autos and ball win the level-1 contact; from level 2 his Eye of Destruction reaches 1000 and Shocking Orb 1050 against her 815 Q, so the poke war is his for the rest of the game.
audit.corrected: Full sides set to Orianna on row 0 and Xerath on rows 1-6, with whys and ratings rewritten to match. Content win[] already held the correct tokens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 and first-item text was generic Orianna boilerplate ('your lane presence doubles', 'Luden's spike'), which is false in a lane she cannot reach.
audit.why: Rite of the Arcane is 5000 range on a 130s cooldown at rank 1 — his level 6 is a map-wide spike and hers is not, since Command: Shockwave is 410 range.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now state his ranges and cooldowns and tell you to farm and flank instead of contest.

audit.whatIsWrong: The R was called 'Rite of the Ancients' — that ability does not exist. No cooldowns stated anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's kit gives Rite of the Arcane (R, 130/115/100, 5000 range), Shocking Orb (E, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11, 1050, hard CC), Eye of Destruction (W, 14/13/12/11/10, 1000) and Arcanopulse (Q, 9/8/7/6/5, 750). His Q, E and R are all projectiles, and his R immobilizes him while he channels — any CC cancels it.
audit.corrected: Real name used; cooldowns and ranges now carried in breakdown.cooldowns, the phase whys and the do's/don'ts.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Shocking Orb 13s->11s, Eye of Destruction 14s, Rite of the Arcane 130s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Body did not answer the title.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten against this enemy's cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.mid claimed protect-ball 'doubles every gank' (lint UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE).
audit.corrected: Replaced with what the ball delivers, plus the correct mid-game plan for a lane you cannot contest.

edits.before: Xerath
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — before Arcanopulse is levelled his 750-range Q cannot answer your step-up.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Eye of Destruction reaches 1000 against your 815 Q — from here the poke war is his and you farm behind minions.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: E completes the kit: ball-on-self beats his engage, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens. The chess match begins.
edits.after: E completes your kit but not your range: hold ball-on-self, dodge sideways on Shocking Orb, and take the safe waves.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: He pokes on a 9s Q and a 14s W while you cannot reach him — give up shove tempo and farm at max range.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane fires from 5000 range and Shocking Orb sets it up — your 410-range R answers none of that.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: His mana items scale the poke harder than your Luden's does here — buy magic resist and farm instead of contesting.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Xerath

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: His artillery reaches every fight — your only path is a flank Shockwave once his 13s Shocking Orb has been spent.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It governs your forward steps. - E Command: Protect spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (E): 13s at rank 1 and still 11s at rank 5 — his only CC, and dodging it means the artillery never converts. - Eye of Destruction (W): 14s at rank 1 — the slow that sets the orb up. - Rite of the Arcane: 130s at rank 1, so a dodged ult buys you two minutes.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you stop contesting: hold the ball as a shield, cross-map with your jungler, and Shockwave only from a flank. Protect-ball brings a shield, speed and your R to the gank.

edits.before: His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: A ball parked on his last-hit spot taxes him at 815 range while his Q still has to charge to reach you.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Your Q is 7s at rank 1 falling to 3s, against a 9s Arcanopulse — take the contact whenever his Q is spent, then pull the ball home.

edits.before: Xerath whiffs Shocking Orb (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Your passive grows on repeat hits — weave autos whenever he steps inside 815.

edits.before: That is Xerath’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Ball-less at his range you are only a target for a 1000-range W.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Your R is 110s at rank 1 — the only way you ever touch him is a fight-opening flank, so never spend it on minions.

edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb from 1050 and chaining artillery while you never get inside your own 815.

edits.before: If Xerath opens the score, reset expectations and respect Shocking Orb (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: A kill funds his mana items and the poke only gets worse, so farm from behind minions and never walk a straight line at him. Two kills: buy magic resist, take safe waves, and save R for a flank in a real fight.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — protect-ball shields whoever closes the gap, and one Shockwave onto an immobile Xerath ends him before he finishes channelling.

edits.before: His Rite of the Ancients (R) is global artillery and his E is a long-range stun that sets it up. You have zero pick pressure back at this range, so hold your ball as a shield and dodge sideways on his E - eating the stun means eating his entire poke rotation plus a jungler.
edits.after: His Rite of the Arcane (R) fires from 5000 range and his 1050-range Shocking Orb sets it up. You have no pick pressure back at that range, so hold your ball as a shield and dodge sideways on the orb - eating it means eating his whole rotation plus a jungler.

notes: Every one of the seven chart rows disagreed across the layers (full said Xerath/Skill..., content and packet said Orianna then Xerath x6). Fabricated ability name 'Rite of the Ancients' replaced with Rite of the Arcane. Note for the champion-level pass: Xerath's Arcanopulse extends beyond its listed 750 base range when charged — the kit file only carries the base number, so the text here stays with the numbers the kit supports (W 1000, E 1050) rather than asserting a charged Q range. | COHERENCE: 1 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
